subject.title: fix(acp): scope Discord thread session keys

question: Should this PR intentionally split inherited Discord configured ACP sessions into fresh per-thread keys without migrating the old parent-scoped session state once the branch is refreshed and proofed?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the fix changes persistent session identity for existing users and current main has moved part of the reset path, so merge readiness depends on maintainer upgrade-state intent rather than code shape alone.

options.title: Require Proof And Accept Fresh Split
options.body: Require a rebase plus redacted live Discord/ACP proof, then accept that old shared parent-scoped ACP state is not migrated because it is the contaminated state.

options.title: Require Migration Policy
options.body: Ask for an explicit migration, recovery, or documented operator path before changing generated keys for existing parent-scoped sessions.

options.title: Pause Or Replace
options.body: Pause this branch or replace it with a maintainer-owned branch if the conflict and proof gaps cannot be resolved cleanly.

recommendation.title: Require Proof And Accept Fresh Split
recommendation.body: Require a rebase plus redacted live Discord/ACP proof, then accept that old shared parent-scoped ACP state is not migrated because it is the contaminated state.
